signature: SUBROUTINE ZGEMQRT( SIDE, TRANS, M, N, K, NB, V, LDV, T, LDT,

params.name: side
params.reference:
-   `= 'L'`: apply Q or $Q^H$ from the Left;
-   `= 'R'`: apply Q or $Q^H$ from the Right.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: No transpose, apply Q;
-   `= 'C'`: Conjugate transpose, apply $Q^H$.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix C. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix C. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: K
params.reference: The number of elementary reflectors whose product defines the matrix Q. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $M \ge K \ge 0$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $N \ge K \ge 0$.

params.name: nb
params.reference: The block size used for the storage of T. $K \ge \mathrm{NB} \ge 1$. This must be the same value of `NB` used to generate T in ZGEQRT.

params.name: V
params.reference: The i-th column must contain the vector which defines the elementary reflector H(i), for $i = 1$,2,...,k, as returned by ZGEQRT in the first K columns of its array argument A.

params.name: ldv
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array V. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: T
params.reference: The upper triangular factors of the block reflectors as returned by ZGEQRT, stored as a `NB`-by-N matrix.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \mathrm{NB}$.

params.name: C
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by Q C, $Q^H$ C, C $Q^H$ or C Q.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array C. $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
